projection_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON array; source order retained; object keys sorted; separators comma/colon; ensure_ascii=false
conservative_rules: A non-Unknown curated controlled body or injury-type value always wins.
Positive concussion evidence is accepted only from an exact concussion code or explicit positive text after the documented negation checks.
An exact catalogue mapping applies only where the corresponding controlled value remains Unknown.
A strict OSIICS body prefix or explicit body text applies only when it yields one unique body candidate.
An exact mapped injury type applies only when its mapped body matches the effective body.
Explicit injury-type text applies only when it yields one unique type candidate and the body evidence is absent or consistent.
The one declared multi-type catalogue row is counted once through its nonspecific primary type while retaining its candidate types.
Ambiguous, conflicting, weak, or unrecognised evidence remains Unknown.
